snippet.title: Odds Chronicles: Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Introducing Odds Chronicles, a new tactical roguelite RPG that features dice-roll battles set on diorama-like stages. You play in a fallen kingdom as Evryn, a former royal bodyguard in that kingdom in a tabletop-inspired fantasy story. Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3058740/Odds_Chronicles/

#IGN #gaming
